pose: A dynamic physical comedy scene. In the center of the frame, the larger feathered dinosaur bursts out of the vegetation in a powerful, running stride, arms wide open with a comically over-ambitious expression. The entire herd of small juvenile sauropods scatters chaotically in all directions around it, their wide, expressive eyes conveying comedic panic. A few juveniles dash toward the foreground corners, while others scramble into the background brush, leaving the hunter completely bewildered by the sudden burst of multi-directional movement.
